witness.note: 074000 identifies the surviving 1522 Jiajing printing; its 1494 preface does not prove an unchanged complete novel in 1494. The later received 120-chapter Mao recension remains distinct.

description: Traces Zhuge Liang's later Northern Expeditions, logistical constraints and contest with Sima Yi through his death at Wuzhang Plains, examining the limits of strategic ingenuity, public duty and the need for institutional succession.
